groups.activity: buy the Bo, Kunai, Tipedo and Lesion blueprints
groups.meta: one visit covers the whole chain
conditions: MR3 is needed to equip Tipedo, MR9 for Lesion — only to use them, not to build them.
Budget three weapon slots for the chain: Bo, Kunai and Tipedo each need to sit claimed in your inventory before the next recipe will accept them.

rows.label: Bo
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 1 Orokin Cell, 900 Salvage, 600 Ferrite, 150 Alloy Plate

rows.label: Kunai
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 5 Morphics, 3,000 Ferrite, 4,000 Nano Spores, 4,000 Salvage

conditions: Rank each to 30 before consuming it — mastery is only awarded for levels actually earned, and Bo, Kunai and Tipedo are each worth full mastery in their own right.
Claim both into inventory before starting Tipedo; an item still sitting unclaimed in the Foundry is not a valid ingredient.
bonuses: Bo and Kunai build in parallel, so the wall clock is 12h here, not 24h.

disclosures.title: don't feed an Incarnon copy
disclosures.body: Bo and Kunai both have Incarnon Genesis adapters from the Circuit. Whether an installed Genesis survives being consumed is unconfirmed; strip it at Cavalero first or build a separate naked copy as the ingredient.

rows.label: Tipedo
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 2 Neural Sensors, 1,600 Polymer Bundle, 1 Kunai, 1 Bo

conditions: Tipedo Prime does not substitute — the Foundry UI may appear to accept it but will not actually consume it. Build the base Tipedo.
Bo is double-booked: it also feeds Cadus. Build two Bo if you want both.

rows.label: Lesion
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 1 Tipedo, 1,400 Plastids, 4 Neurodes, 2,300 Nano Spores

conditions: Forma, Orokin Catalyst, Exilus Weapon Adapter and Focus Lens do not carry over from a consumed weapon — build a fresh, naked Tipedo as the ingredient rather than feeding in an invested one.
Rank Tipedo to 30 before feeding it in for its mastery.
bonuses: About 140,000 credits and 36 hours end to end (Bo and Kunai in parallel, then Tipedo, then Lesion) versus 150 platinum to buy the finished Lesion outright — that price gap is why nobody rushes this chain.
